definitions.short: a thorn ; also (from its keenness for scratching) a gem, probably the diamond
definitions.full: H8068. shamir I. שָׁמִיר noun masculine : Ezek 3:9 thorn(s), adamant, flint ; — absolute ׳שׁ Isa 5:6 +; suffix שְׁמִירוֺ 10:17 ; — 1 collective thorns, thorn-bushes , token of waste-land, only Isaiah, + שַׁיִת Isa 5:6 ; 7:23-24 , 25 ; 27:4 ; figurative 9:17 ; 10:17 ; שׁ ׳קוֺץ 32:13 . 2 adamant , as sharp, ׳שׁ בְּצִמֹּרֶן ֗֗֗ כְּתוּבָה Jer 17:1 (|| בַּדְוֶל בְּעֵט ); as hard, figurative of prophet's firmness Ezek 3:9 ; Zech 7:12 figurative of hard heart.
definitions.rootNote: from 8104 in the original sense of pricking ;
